methods.name: PES transformation
methods.description: Transforms the potential energy surface without changing the global minimum or relative energies of local minima, defined by transformed energy E~(X) = min{E(X)} where energy minimization is performed starting from nuclear coordinates X

methods.name: Monte Carlo
methods.description: Unbiased global optimization algorithm runs conducted starting from initial random configurations rather than biased morphology seeds

methods.name: Polak-Ribiere variant of the conjugate gradient algorithm
methods.description: Used to perform energy minimizations starting from X.

methods.name: canonical Monte Carlo simulation
methods.description: Used to explore the energy landscape for the transformed energy function at a constant reduced temperature.

methods.name: conjugate gradient search
methods.description: Energy minimization requiring RMS gradient to fall below 0.01 in reduced units and energy change less than 0.1ǫ between consecutive steps.

methods.name: canonical simulation
methods.description: Simulation used to obtain lowest energy structures for subsequent reoptimization.

methods.name: angular moves
methods.description: Move employed for an atom with all other atoms fixed if the highest pair energy rises above a fraction α of the lowest pair energy.
